children: RNS Number : 6847T  AJ Bell PLC  07 September 2026
Fiona Fry - Directorships Held by the Director in a Publicly Quoted Company

In accordance with the Financial Conduct Authority's UK Listing Rule 6.4.9R(2), AJ Bell announces that Fiona Fry, Non-Executive Director, has been appointed as a Non-Executive Director of Polar Capital Holdings PLC, with effect from the conclusion of their AGM on 24 September 2026.
Kina Sinclair, General Counsel & Company Secretary                              0345 40 89 100
